title: Objective Taxonomy
description: Controlled vocabulary for attacker operational objectives. Maps to ATT&CK tactics but adds semantic intent that ATT&CK tactics do not capture.

GOAL_CREDENTIAL_ACCESS.name: credential_access
GOAL_CREDENTIAL_ACCESS.description: Attacker seeks credentials — passwords, tokens, hashes, certificates — to enable further access.

GOAL_LATERAL_MOVEMENT.name: lateral_movement
GOAL_LATERAL_MOVEMENT.description: Attacker moves from initial foothold to additional systems or identity boundaries.

GOAL_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.name: privilege_escalation
GOAL_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.description: Attacker seeks higher-level permissions — local admin, domain admin, global admin in cloud.

GOAL_PERSISTENCE.name: persistence
GOAL_PERSISTENCE.description: Attacker establishes mechanisms to maintain access across restarts, credential changes, or detection events.

GOAL_DEFENSE_EVASION.name: defense_evasion
GOAL_DEFENSE_EVASION.description: Attacker actively avoids detection by security controls, EDR, SIEM, or analyst review.

GOAL_DATA_EXFILTRATION.name: data_exfiltration
GOAL_DATA_EXFILTRATION.description: Attacker collects and transfers sensitive data out of the environment.

GOAL_COLLECTION.name: collection
GOAL_COLLECTION.description: Attacker gathers data of interest prior to exfiltration.

GOAL_IMPACT.name: impact
GOAL_IMPACT.description: Attacker seeks to disrupt, destroy, or manipulate systems, data, or operations.

GOAL_INITIAL_ACCESS.name: initial_access
GOAL_INITIAL_ACCESS.description: Attacker gains initial foothold into the target environment.

GOAL_EXECUTION.name: execution
GOAL_EXECUTION.description: Attacker runs malicious code on a local or remote system.

categories.identity_compromise: Goals related to obtaining or abusing credentials and identity.
categories.data_exfiltration: Goals related to collecting and stealing data.
categories.persistence: Goals related to maintaining access and executing code.
categories.privilege_escalation: Goals related to gaining elevated permissions.
categories.impact: Goals related to disruption, destruction, or manipulation.
categories.resource_development: Goals related to building attack infrastructure.
